test_title: PYST 71: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 28 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

There's __no waters__ in the swimming pool.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect plural form "**waters**" used after "**no**."
 
• The word "**water**" is an uncountable noun and should not be pluralized.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**no water**."
 
• Thus, the error is located in the underlined part of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"There's no **water **in the swimming pool."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "No improvement"** – This would be the correct option if the sentence were already correct, but it contains an error.
 
• **Option 3: "no watering"** – This phrase is incorrect in this context as it changes the meaning of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "none water"** – This phrase is grammatically incorrect.
